title: A pack sealed from a test file whose start URL names another origin still backs the claim
gap: pack_disagreement retargets the expected step wording to the pack's own front-matter url, so the url Kane opened is never compared with the one Attest wrote (the detected local server). A claim whose objective has no URL reads the same on any origin. Needs the start URL Attest wrote recorded with the run and compared on read-back.

input.source: Recorded capture tests/fixtures/kane/author_pass.pack.zip (event-day smoke run, sanitized); not live Kane.
